metadata.description: Red tiles form a vyshyvanka-inspired sequence of embroidered diamonds with cross-shaped centers. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Broken spiral approach surround the motif, with tidal coves along the lower route. 4 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 7 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
